name: Smokestack
role: Colorshifted prison: symmetric sacrifice engine on soot counters.
printings: MB2, PLST, SLC, USG, V14, VMA
note: Locked >BG; BG moves/removes counters; soot-counter sac lock.
text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may put a soot counter on this artifact.
At the beginning of each player's upkeep, that player sacrifices a permanent of their choice for each soot counter on this artifact.

name: Tangle Wire
role: Colorshifted soft-lock; FADE counters are a proliferate target.
note: Locked >UG; Fading 4 counters, UG proliferates to extend lock.
text:
Fading 4 (This artifact enters with four fade counters on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a fade counter from it. If you can't, sacrifice it.)
At the beginning of each player's upkeep, that player taps an untapped artifact, creature, or land they control for each fade counter on this artifact.

name: Ensnaring Bridge
role: Colorshifted attack lock; empty hand shuts off attackers.
note: Locked >BR; BR wants empty hand (discard) for the lock.
text: Creatures with power greater than the number of cards in your hand can't attack.

name: Opposition
role: Colorshifted tapper-lock fed by a wide creature board.
note: Locked >GW; GW floods creatures by turn four to fuel taps.
text: Tap an untapped creature you control: Tap target artifact, creature, or land.

name: Winter Orb
role: Classic mana-denial prison; slows everyone to one land/turn.
printings: 2ED, 30A, 3ED, 4BB, 4ED, 5ED, CED, CEI, EMA, FBB, LEA, LEB, ME1, PRM, PTC, SLD, SUM, WC97
note: Core colorless mana-denial; pairs with cheap-rock prison decks.
text: As long as this artifact is untapped, players can't untap more than one land during their untap steps.

name: Static Orb
role: Harder Winter Orb; caps untaps at two permanents total.
note: Stronger stasis; rewards low-permanent prison shells.
text: As long as this artifact is untapped, players can't untap more than two permanents during their untap steps.

name: Sphere of Resistance
role: Symmetric spell tax; slows the whole table evenly.
note: Cheap symmetric tax; good prison glue, low power.
text: Spells cost {1} more to cast.

name: Trinisphere
role: Hard three-mana floor; very punishing tax effect.
note: Flag too_strong: 3-mana floor can hard-lock low-curve cube.
text: As long as this artifact is untapped, each spell that would cost less than three mana to cast costs three mana to cast.

name: Crucible of Worlds
role: Land-recursion engine; enables fetch/sac-land grind value.
printings: 10E, 2X2, 5DN, J13, M19, MPS, PIP, PM19, PRM, PWOR, SLD
note: Grindy land recursion; supports Glacial-Chasm/sac-land prison loops.
text: You may play lands from your graveyard.

name: Crawlspace
role: Defensive attack cap; only two creatures attack you/combat.
note: Buys time for slow lock/alt-win shells; pure defense.
text: No more than two creatures can attack you each combat.

name: Lantern of Insight
role: Lantern-control core: see tops, enable selective mill lock.
errata_proposal: Add: 'At the beginning of your upkeep, target player mills a card.' so it threatens a clock alone.
note: Lantern win (#15); errata to mill 1/upkeep, real clock.
text:
Players play with the top card of their libraries revealed.
{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Target player shuffles.

name: Codex Shredder
role: Lantern win: repeatable mill plus late-game card return.
note: Already mills 1/turn solo; the lantern-deck primary clock.
text:
{T}: Target player mills a card.
{5}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Return target card from your graveyard to your hand.

name: Pyxis of Pandemonium
role: Lantern-style exile clock; symmetric face-down library strip.
errata_proposal: Add: 'When you activate the first ability each turn, the chosen opponent mills a card.' so exiling also threatens decking.
note: Lantern win (#15); errata so exile also mills, real clock.
text:
{T}: Each player exiles the top card of their library face down.
{7}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Each player turns face up all cards they own exiled with this artifact, then puts all permanent cards among them onto the battlefield.

name: Ghoulcaller's Bell
role: Lantern win: cheap symmetric mill, fuels graveyard themes.
note: Already mills each player 1/turn; lantern + self-mill enabler.
text: {T}: Each player mills a card.

name: Mindcrank
role: Lantern/mill payoff: life loss snowballs into deck-out.
errata_proposal: Add: 'At the beginning of your upkeep, target opponent mills a card.' so it advances the mill plan without external life-loss.
note: Lantern win (#15); errata to self-mill so it acts alone.
text: Whenever an opponent loses life, that player mills that many cards.

name: Howling Mine
role: Symmetric extra draw; fuels honest combo and decking.
printings: 10E, 2ED, 30A, 3ED, 4BB, 4ED, 5ED, 6ED, 7ED, 8ED, 9ED, BRR, C16, CED, CEI, CMD, FBB, LEA, LEB, M10, PLST, PS11, PTC, SLD, SUM
note: Symmetric draw; feeds Ad Nauseam/storm and lantern decking.
text: At the beginning of each player's draw step, if this artifact is untapped, that player draws an additional card.

name: Storage Matrix
role: Untap-restriction prison; decision-rich which type untaps.
note: Decision-intensive untap lock; low power, very on-philosophy.
text: As long as this artifact is untapped, each player chooses artifact, creature, or land during their untap step. That player can untap only permanents of the chosen type this step.

name: Cursed Totem
role: Hatebear-style lock on creature activated abilities.
note: Shuts creature abilities incl. Opposition-style tappers; sideways prison.
text: Activated abilities of creatures can't be activated.

name: Tsabo's Web
role: Cantrip land-lock; taxes utility/man-lands, replaces itself.
note: Cantrip soft-lock on utility lands; never a dead draw.
text:
When this artifact enters, draw a card.
Each land with an activated ability that isn't a mana ability doesn't untap during its controller's untap step.

name: Defense Grid
role: Protects your combo turn; taxes opponents' interaction.
note: Shields honest-combo turns from counters; asymmetric tax.
text: Each spell costs {3} more to cast except during its controller's turn.

name: Damping Sphere
role: Anti-ramp and anti-storm tax; curbs degenerate turns.
note: Caps big-mana lands and storm; honest-combo speed-bump.
text:
If a land is tapped for two or more mana, it produces {C} instead of any other type and amount.
Each spell a player casts costs {1} more to cast for each other spell that player has cast this turn.

name: Teferi's Puzzle Box
role: Hand-randomizer lock engine (spec #14 puzzle-box plan).
note: Spec #14 puzzle-box lock piece; pairs with draw-denial.
text: At the beginning of each player's draw step, that player puts the cards in their hand on the bottom of their library in any order, then draws that many cards.

name: Possessed Portal
role: Top-end hard lock: stops draws, grinds board to zero.
note: Fragile 8-mana payoff lock; expensive enough to stay fair.
text:
If a player would draw a card, that player skips that draw instead.
At the beginning of each end step, each player sacrifices a permanent of their choice unless they discard a card.

name: Mind Stone
role: Colorless rock that cashes for a card late.
note: Low-power rock; never flooding because it sacs for card.
text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{1}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card.

name: Star Compass
role: Tapland-style fixing rock keyed to your basics.
note: Slow color fixing; enters tapped, low power by design.
text:
This artifact enters tapped.
{T}: Add one mana of any color that a basic land you control could produce.

name: Coldsteel Heart
role: Two-mana fixing rock; enters tapped, fixed color.
printings: 2X2, C15, CM2, CSP, HA4, J22, PLST
note: Tapped fixing rock; modest, supports multicolor lock decks.
text:
This artifact enters tapped.
As this artifact enters, choose a color.
{T}: Add one mana of the chosen color.

name: Fellwar Stone
role: Two-mana fixing rock keyed to opponents' lands.
note: Untapped fixing rock; mild, period-appropriate, no fast-mana jump.
text: {T}: Add one mana of any color that a land an opponent controls could produce.

printings: C18, CMM, E02, EMA, OTC, PLST, TSP, TSR, UMA

text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{1}, {T}: Add one mana of any color.

printings: BRR, C13, C14, C21, CM2, IMA, LTC, NPH, PNPH, PRM
note: Slow rock + lifegain; buffers life for Ad Nauseam.

name: Worn Powerstone
role: Tapped two-mana ramp rock for big-mana sinks.
note: Tapped ramp; powers Braids/mana-sink decks without fast-mana jump.
text:
This artifact enters tapped.
{T}: Add {C}{C}.

name: Expedition Map
role: Land tutor; fetches utility lands for lock plans.
note: Fetches Glacial Chasm/Tabernacle utility lands; enables prison toolbox.
text: {2}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Search your library for a land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

note: Mono-R note: creature-untap lock; lives in Red, not colorless.
text: Players can't untap more than one creature during their untap steps.

Enchant creature
